input: 68 small-variant records on chromosome 21 chosen for the transcript attributes within 5 kb: exonic positions on transcripts of every MANE Select and MANE Plus Clinical, APPRIS grade (the M grades included), transcript support level shape (a digit, NA, and the values assigned to a previous version), CCDS, RefSeq (single and list), UniProt Swiss-Prot, TrEMBL (single and list), UniParc and UniProt isoform class (a value or the cache's `-`), gene phenotype count (zero and non-zero), canonical and symbol class seen on the chromosome, plus a stem position, a loop position, a deletion across a stem/loop boundary and an insertion on miRNA transcripts carrying an ncRNA structure; the chromosome 21 records of the GRCh37 golden corpus are candidates too; the reference base is the GRCh37 primary assembly's

divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with

generator: candidate records annotated with Ensembl VEP under the corpus flags, then scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py select --release 116 --assembly GRCh37 --suite attrs37=<reference>=<candidates> --k 2 --seed 1 --cache <converted slice> --family-columns MANE=,APPRIS=,TSL=,CCDS,SWISSPROT,TREMBL,UNIPARC,UNIPROT_ISOFORM,RefSeq,GENE_PHENO,miRNA= --covers ... --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --flag=--symbol --flag=--biotype --flag=--canonical --flag=--mane --flag=--tsl --flag=--appris --flag=--ccds --flag=--protein --flag=--protein_version --flag=--uniprot --flag=--xref_refseq --flag=--gene_phenotype --flag=--mirna --flag=--transcript_version --flag=--gene_version; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 over the chromosome 21 slice scripts/data/storable_to_json.pl converted from the Ensembl VEP 116 GRCh37 cache; scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus; scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py classify
